_note: Every source is credited and licensed. `distribution` is `committed` for sources whose licence page was checked (public domain, CC0 or CC BY) and `local` for footage we may not redistribute; a committed clip may only use committed sources. A piece's `start`/`end` are seconds of the source; `speed` below 1 slows it; `pingpong` plays it forward then backward; `repeat` plays the piece again after itself; `onset_in_piece_s` is the second of the piece (after speed) where the water visibly jumps.
